periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis angled downward towards the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with the vertical-diagonal axis length exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward elongation extending the patch significantly below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior profile with a relatively flat transverse edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band representing a large percentage of the visible dorsal torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant cranial gap between the ears, roughly equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, convex semicircular top boundaries.
